item.title: Hong Kong and Macao Deepen Financial Cooperation with Updated Agreement
item.description: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and the Monetary Authority of Macao (AMCM) held a meeting on March 3 to strengthen bilateral financial cooperation and signed a revised MoU. item.description: South Korean regulators and lawmakers have agreed to cap major shareholder stakes in cryptocurrency exchanges at 20%, despite opposition from the industry.
